Gyro

Each leg has its own filtered /lN/imu/data (sensor_msgs/Imu) and compact /lN/imu/roll_pitch_deg (std_msgs/String, e.g. roll_deg=12.34,pitch_deg=-5.67). Debug unfiltered: /lN/imu/data_raw below.

Zero roll / pitch only updates the UI reference; it does not command the robot or change IMU firmware calibration.
